scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web && npm run build:server && npm run build:cli
scripts.cli: npm run build:shared && npm run build:cli && node apps/cli/dist/index.js
scripts.cli:agent: npm run --silent build:shared && npm run --silent build:cli && node apps/cli/dist/index.js --compact
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --workspace apps/server run start
scripts.test: npm --workspace packages/shared run test && npm --workspace apps/server run test && npm --workspace apps/cli run test
scripts.verify:all: npm run build && npm run test:all
